mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) signals monetary easing, compressing equity discount rates and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS (negative).
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS 3mo change is negative over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is the YoY change in CPIAUCSL.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 3-month increases in PAYEMS and decreases in UNRATE signal a tightening labor market, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is PAYEMS 3mo change > 0 and UNRATE 3mo change < 0.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where PAYEMS 3mo change > 0 and UNRATE 3mo change < 0 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 qtr-on-qtr growth > 2.0% and INDPRO > 110.0), S&P 500 is overvalued, leading to negative 60-day returns. The signal is GDPC1 and INDPRO.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where GDPC1 qtr-on-qtr growth > 2.0% and INDPRO > 110.0 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 110.0 (a 3-month low), it signals economic weakness, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is INDPRO < 110.0.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 3-month increases in RSAFS and HOUST signal strong consumer demand, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is RSAFS 3mo change > 0 and HOUST 3mo change > 0.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where RSAFS 3mo change > 0 and HOUST 3mo change > 0 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market, leading to wage pressures and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is UNRATE < 4.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS falls below 370,000 million dollars (a 3-month low), it signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is RSAFS < 370000.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where RSAFS < 370000 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.
